barcode_url.description: The URL of the barcode for the receipt if available.

image_url.description: The URL for the image of the receipt if available.

items.description: List of the items on the receipt.

merchant_consumer_token.description: The consumer token provided by the merchant.

merchant_mid.description: A unique ID for each POS, assigned by merchant bank.

merchant_receipt_id.description: Your unique ID rendered for each sale.  This field will be the same for split tenders.

merchant_total_amount.description: Total amount charged across all payment types.

order_ts.description: The time at which the order was placed with the merchant in RFC3339. UTC if possible.

payments.description: List of payments made as part of the receipt.

purchase_ts.description: The time at which the purchase occurred in RFC3339. UTC if possible.

address_line_one.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

address_line_two.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

city.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

country.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

postal_code.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

state.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

display_name.description: The banner name of the store of the purchase.

name.description: The legal/listed name of the store of the purchase.

phone_number.description: For brick and mortar transactions only.

amount_paid.description: The amount paid for the item.

discount_price_per_unit.description: The amount paid for the item.

full_price_per_unit.description: The regular price for the item specified in the item id.

image_url.description: The URL for the image of the item, if available.

merchant_item_id.description: Unique ID for the item sold in the transaction.

quantity.description: The number of the same items purchased.

sku.description: Store specific ID of the item.

tags.description: List of tags formatted as key-value pairs.

items.description: A key-value pair that represents some form of tagged information.

unit_type.description: The unit of measure for the quantity.

arn.description: A unique 23-digit number that tags a credit or debit card transaction when it goes from the merchant's bank to the cardholder's bank. Also called a trace ID.

auth_code.description: Six digit alphanumeric code passed between banks that signal a transaction is possible.

bin.description: Bank Identification Number associated with the card used. Some BINs will be 8 digits in the near future.

card_issuer.description: The card issuer for the card used on this payment.

card_last_four.description: Last 4 digits on the debit/credit card.

is_virtual_card.description: Indicates whether the payment is virtual or not.

other_negative_amounts.description: Any other amounts that are negative.

other_positive_amounts.description: Any other amounts that are positive.

payment_type.description: Credit card vs debit card transaction.

scheme.description: The network the card was issued on.

shipping_amount.description: The amount paid to ship for a delivery fulfillment type.

subtotal_amount.description: Total amount less tax amount less shipping less tip.
